title: Squared Gaussian conditional slope identity
statement: For every real number $\rho$ with $0<\rho<1$, if $s=(1-\rho)/\sqrt{1-\rho^2}$ is the Gaussian conditional slope, then $1+s^2=\frac{2}{1+\rho}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ is a real number in the open interval $(0,1)$
